body: We used to have this in the business logic chapter. It got moved to concurrency but that requirement is a lot more low level so I think we still need  a more business logic level requirement as well, (see the second half of [this comment](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2960#issuecomment-2879045286).)

comments.body:
Level 2 requirement for section 2.3.

> Verify that business logic level locking mechanisms are used to ensure that limited quantity resources (such as theater seats or delivery slots) are cannot be accidentally or intentionally double booked by manipulating the application's logic.

What do you think @elarlang ?

Some shortening:
> Verify that business logic level locking mechanisms are used to ensure that limited quantity resources (such as theater seats or delivery slots) cannot be double-booked by manipulating the application's logic.

but it still feels like a duplicate of 15.4.3

> Some shortening:
> 
> > Verify that business logic level locking mechanisms are used to ensure that limited quantity resources (such as theater seats or delivery slots) cannot be double-booked by manipulating the application's logic.
> 
> but it still feels like a duplicate of 15.4.3

So I would argue that it is not a duplicate because the exploit mechanism would be different and because the fix mechanism would be different. In 15.4.3 the the fix would be highly technical and relate to programming language primitives, in this requirement it is much more likely to be some sort of logic level verification or fix, possibly tracked in the database.

title: Create a L2 TOCTOU requirement
